logline: High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.
continuity_notes: Picks up right after Alexander commands his men to secure the chapel and vows to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana; inside the cathedral, the wedding guests arrive and the conspirators finalize their sinister plot.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide establishing shot looking up at the imposing stone Gothic cathedral as noble guests in formal Regency attire ascend the grand steps.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Somber cathedral bells tolling and the distant murmur of arriving carriages.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot of an ornate black and gold royal carriage pulling up to the cobblestone courtyard. A footman in white gloves steps forward and opens the carriage door.

segments.label: FOOTMAN (Formal, Resonant)
segments.speaker: FOOTMAN
segments.text: The Harrington family.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Lord Harrington in a tailored black tailcoat and white waistcoat steps down from the carriage, turning to extend his gloved hand to Lady Harrington, who gracefully descends.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Harrington takes his hand and steps onto the pavement, clutching a velvet reticule.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Smug, Impressed)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot tracking slightly as Lord and Lady Harrington pause arm-in-arm, taking in the gathering crowd of high society.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot from behind as they ascend the stone steps toward the arched cathedral entrance.

segments.label: LORD HARRINGTON (Ambitious, Proud)
segments.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
segments.text: And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up profile of Lady Harrington, her eyes glistening with cruel satisfaction in the soft sunlight.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Malicious, Taunting)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: Imagine Juliana seeing this.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.

segments.label: LORD HARRINGTON (Sinister, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
segments.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Pleased, Cold)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: Good.

segments.label: LORD HARRINGTON (Chuckling, Scornful)
segments.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
segments.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Vindictive, Pious)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Anticipatory, Eager)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: We have an excellent view.

segments.label: LORD HARRINGTON (Inquiring, Subdued)
segments.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
segments.text: Of the wedding?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up two-shot as Lady Harrington turns her head toward Lord Harrington with a dark, knowing smirk.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Chilling, Sarcastic)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: And everything that comes after it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Nervous, Determined)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Everything must go perfectly.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Scheming)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: All entrances are covered?

segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Obedient, Firm)
segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
segments.text: Every one, my Lord.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculating)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Good.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless, Victorious)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadly, Uncompromising)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: And its witch will be dead.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide symmetrical shot down the candlelit aisle as the double doors part, flooding the cathedral with brilliant golden daylight.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Rupert turning his head sharply, his eyes widening in awe.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Framed wide shot of Catherine silhouetted in the bright doorway, wearing a breathtaking cream and gold imperial bridal gown with puffed sleeves and an exquisite sheer veil.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Majestic high-angle wide tracking shot following Catherine from behind as her magnificent cathedral-length veil trails down the aisle between seated guests.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Harrington leaning forward from her pew, utterly captivated.

segments.label: LADY HARRINGTON (Awestruck, Whispering)
segments.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
segments.text: She looks like a queen.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert at the altar, a proud, possessive smile breaking across his handsome face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot as Catherine reaches the top of the altar steps. Rupert steps forward and takes her gloved hands into his.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enamored, Flattering)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You look more queen than bride.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight two-shot profile of Catherine and Rupert clasping hands intimately, gazing into each other's eyes with shared aristocratic vanity.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Coquettish)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.
